title: Soldier on BRP Sierra Madre in need of emergency medical evacuation: AFP
summary: A Philippine Navy personnel stationed aboard the BRP Sierra Madre in Ayungin Shoal required emergency medical evacuation, the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) said Thursday.
